title: Dynamics of the Liquidity Profile in Concentrated Liquidity Provision: An SPIDE Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.30539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We model the dynamics of the liquidity profile in Uniswap~V3 and other concentrated-liquidity automated market makers with a stochastic partial integro-differential equation (SPIDE). The profile, the aggregate of all provider positions across tick space, evolves under a degenerate Sturm--Liouville operator, which encodes mean-reverting concentration around the market price, coupled with a Hilbert--Schmidt integral operator, which captures nonlocal redistribution driven by provider repositioning. We establish existence and uniqueness of the mild solution in a weighted $L^2$ space built on the Gegenbauer eigensystem, and reduce the SPIDE to a coupled system of linear stochastic differential equations whose low-order modes describe the level, slope, and curvature of the profile. Pairing the SPIDE with a log-price process yields tractable expressions for pool reserves, pool value, and loss-versus-rebalancing under Ornstein--Uhlenbeck-type an

translated_title: 集中流动性提供中流动性轮廓的动力学：一种SPIDE方法
translated_abstract: 我们用随机偏积分微分方程（SPIDE）对Uniswap V3及其他集中流动性自动做市商中流动性轮廓的动力学进行建模。该轮廓是所有流动性提供者在tick空间上头寸的总和，其在一个退化的Sturm–Liouville算子下演化，该算子编码了围绕市场价格的均值回归式集中，并与一个Hilbert–Schmidt积分算子相耦合，后者捕捉由流动性提供者重新定位所驱动的非局部再分配。我们在基于Gegenbauer特征系统构建的加权 $L^2$ 空间中证明了温和解的存在性与唯一性，并将该SPIDE简化为一个耦合的线性随机微分方程组，其低阶模态分别刻画了轮廓的水平、斜率和曲率。将该SPIDE与对数价格过程相结合，在Ornstein–Uhlenbeck型资产价格动态下得到了资金池储备、资金池价值以及相对再平衡损失（LVR）的可解析表达式。
tldr: 本文首次用随机偏积分微分方程（SPIDE）建模Uniswap V3等集中流动性做市商中流动性轮廓的动态演化，证明了解的存在唯一性，并推导出资金池储备、价值及LVR的解析表达式。
en_tdlr: This paper models the dynamics of the liquidity profile in Uniswap V3-style concentrated-liquidity AMMs with a stochastic partial integro-differential equation (SPIDE), establishes existence and uniqueness of the mild solution, and derives tractable expressions for pool reserves, pool value, and loss-versus-rebalancing.
